signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

roles.title: Move to New Zealand - Product Strategist

bullets: Value & Problem Framing: Articulate client value and frame the problem worth solving - what outcome the client is actually buying.
Communication: Clearly communicate the problem, hypotheses and success measures.
Delivery Constraints: Ensure delivery teams work solely on funded backlog items, constraining product delivery as necessary.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with internal and client stakeholders to ensure both functional and commercial objectives are met.
Scope Management: Lead discovery and manage scope - including using AI to rapidly prototype and test ideas - to deliver maximum value, while ensuring efficient use of resources.
